sanskrit_verse: भर्त्रा प्रीतेन यद् दत्तं स्त्रियै तस्मिन् मृतेsपि तत् । सा यथाकाममश्नीयाद्दद्याद्वा स्थावरादृते ॥
transliteration: bhartrā prītena yad dattaṃ striyai tasmin mṛte 'pi tat | sā yathākāmam aśnīyād dadyād vā sthāvarād ṛte ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Whatever property is given by a pleased husband to his wife, that remains hers even upon his death, except immovable property; she may use it at will or bestow it further.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious consent of the giver
Causation arises from voluntary act of transfer
Capacity-based responsibility lies in acceptance and continuity of ownership
Restoration logic centers on uninterrupted flow of proprietary rights
Consciousness alignment occurs through honoring expressed intent
executable_legal_axioms: IF husband voluntarily transfers movable property to wife THEN wife retains absolute right post-death
IF property type is immovable THEN exclusion rule applies automatically
IF wife exercises usage or re-transfer THEN no external claimant has standing
IF intent is clearly documented THEN capacity validation overrides lineage defaults
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving spousal inheritance, the Supreme Court shall prioritize documented voluntary transfer over statutory default. The threshold of responsibility rests on proof of conscious consent, not bloodline. Authority hierarchy recognizes spousal unity above familial claims, aligning with Dharma's non-punitive restoration framework.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through witnessed or recorded voluntary gift. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as uninterrupted entitlement sequence. Proportional responsibility aligns with scope of ownership transferred. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that rightful possession requires no penalty—only recognition.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion process: Validate original gift documentation and spousal acknowledgment
Responsibility assumption protocol: Wife assumes full custodianship without condition
Capacity restoration: Reaffirm societal recognition of her autonomous economic agency
Integrity reintegration: Ensure third-party claims do not disrupt consecrated transfer
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this directive establishes Dharma as the sole adjudicator. Property law flows from conscious giving, not punitive regulation. Reality is non-punitive; consciousness is sovereign.
